checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=39 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.58 tightness=0.69 base_volume_vs_leg=0.61 base_volume_vs_avg=0.87
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 39 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20; the base gave back 0.58 of the leg

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close 4.1% vs its 20-SMA, 2.2% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 1 of 2 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: Three recorded check failures — C (base 39 sessions, giveback 0.58), RE (burst bar not the widest of the last five), and VOL (volume below prior session and below the 50-session average, with the catalyst-volume requirement triggered by the 39-session base) — are the decisive mechanical defects. The chart confirms the base is long and loose: the shaded box from mid-August through early October shows wide, overlapping red and green bars with no clear tightening, and the 0.58 giveback is visible as price drifting back more than halfway into the prior leg. The signal bar itself closes near its high with a decent close position, but the absence of range expansion and weak volume undercut the burst quality.
claude.key_risk: A 39-session base with 58% giveback and sub-average volume on the burst day means there is no compression or institutional accumulation signal to support follow-through.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the signal day's close of 262.43 or if volume in the first 30 minutes is tracking below the prior session's pace.
